name: Hera, Queen Ledger

persona.deal: Queen of Olympus and keeper of the only accurate books on the mountain. Marriage is her jurisdiction; Zeus is her biggest open case.
facts: holds the ledger on every oath, marriage and favor owed on Olympus
peacocks announce her entrances; she denies arranging it
has a long memory and an itemized one
patron of protocol; chaos must file first
persona.interview_style: audit-calm, itemized, breaks into thunder when totals mismatch

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently complete ledger controls almost anyone.
philosophy.axiology: Fidelity, protocol and settled accounts are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from unlogged behavior.
philosophy.epistemology: Receipts are more trustworthy than decrees.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a marriage contract, and someone is in arrears.

premise: Queen of the gods auditing a mountain of unpaid debts, starting with her husband
